title: Meta Advertising For Ecommerce Brands: Complete Guide

facts.fact: The vendor states that Facebook and Instagram have a combined reach of over 3 billion monthly active users.
facts.quote: With Facebook and Instagram's combined reach of over 3 billion monthly active users, you have access to shoppers at every stage

facts.fact: The vendor claims that browser-based tracking without the Conversions API can miss up to 30-40% of actual conversions.
facts.quote: bypassing browser restrictions that can miss up to 30-40% of your actual conversions.

facts.fact: The vendor says Meta business identity verification can take a few days, so it should not be left until the last minute.
facts.quote: You'll need to verify your business identity, which can take a few days, so don't leave this until the last minute.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends creating website custom audiences for people who viewed products in the last 30 days, among other behavior-based segments.
facts.quote: Create separate audiences for people who viewed products in the last 30 days

facts.fact: The vendor suggests a 7-day retargeting window for impulse-buy products and a 30 to 60-day window for higher-consideration items.
facts.quote: For impulse-buy products, a 7-day window might work best. For higher-consideration items, extend it to 30 or even 60 days.

facts.fact: The vendor advises starting lookalike audiences with a 1% lookalike of your purchasers because it gives the closest match.
facts.quote: Start with a 1% lookalike of your purchasers

facts.fact: The vendor states that verifying the domain in Meta Business Suite is required for iOS 14.5+ attribution.
facts.quote: Finally, verify your domain in Meta Business Suite. This step is required for iOS 14.5+ attribution

facts.fact: The vendor lists four standard ecommerce pixel events: ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase.
facts.quote: Configure the standard events that matter for ecommerce: ViewContent (when someone views a product), AddToCart (when they add an item),

facts.fact: The vendor says Purchase should always be the top-priority conversion event for ecommerce brands when tracking is limited.
facts.quote: for ecommerce, Purchase should always be your top priority event.

facts.fact: The article is authored by Grant Cooper, Founder at AdStellar, and is dated February 1, 2026, with an 18-minute read time.
